title: provision_user_mailboxes: batch 6 INSERTs
description:
provision_user_mailboxes() is called unconditionally at the top of route_method() for every JMAP request, including reads. It issues 6 sequential INSERT OR IGNORE queries. For already-provisioned users all 6 are no-ops, but they still consume 6 SQLite write-lock round-trips per request. SQLite serialises writers, so under concurrent load this multiplies lock contention by 6x for every authenticated request.

Fix: check first with SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_mailboxes WHERE user_id=? and skip if count=6, or batch into a single multi-row INSERT OR IGNORE VALUES (...),(...),... . Alternatively, provision once at user-creation time and remove the call from the hot request path entirely.
